class.name: IvySettings
class.brief_description: Serializable configuration resource for procedural ivy growth simulation.
class.description: [IvySettings] exposes all parameters used by [IvyGenerator] to the Godot Inspector and GDScript, and can be saved and loaded as [code].tres[/code] or [code].res[/code] preset resources.

members.member: Steering weight pulling active vine tips up the scalar attraction gradient of the guidance image ([code]>= 0[/code]).
Steering weight repelling active tips away from nearby unrelated vine points within [member crowding_radius] ([code]>= 0[/code]).
Deflection angle in degrees for newly spawned lateral branches, within [code](0, 90][/code].
Per-step probability in [code][0, 1][/code] of spawning a side branch after [member min_branch_interval] unbranched steps.
Steering weight aligning active vine tips along attraction iso-contours (for example, following mortar grooves between bricks; [code]>= 0[/code]).
Local spatial search radius used for self-avoidance steering and crowding termination. A value of [code]0.0[/code] disables spatial crowding and avoidance checks.
Finite-difference step in UV space used to evaluate the attraction gradient ([code]> 0[/code]).

Dimensionless step attraction gain where gradient and contour steering reach 50% strength ([code]>= 0[/code]). Prevents ridge zig-zagging across thin grooves; [code]0.0[/code] applies unattenuated unit steering.
Initial radial thickness assigned to root points and newly grown vine tips ([code]> 0[/code]).
Number of unrelated neighbor points within [member crowding_radius] at which a tip terminates. A value of [code]0[/code] disables crowding termination.
Hard cap on total points allowed in the generated growth graph ([code]> 0[/code] and [code]>= start_count[/code]).
Maximum number of global Phase 1 growth iterations executed by [method IvyGenerator.generate] ([code]> 0[/code]).
Maximum radial thickness that living vascular stems can reach ([code]>= initial_thickness[/code]).

Maximum steps an active tip may curve laterally across the soft canopy band near the top edge of the wall before stopping cleanly. A value of [code]0[/code] stops tips immediately at the top boundary.
Minimum unbranched steps required after starting or forking before a tip may spawn another side branch ([code]>= 0[/code]).
Minimum radial thickness preserved for withered branches so dried twigs remain visible ([code]0 < min_withered_thickness <= initial_thickness[/code]).
Steering weight preserving each tip's previous growth direction ([code]>= 0[/code]; [code]momentum_weight + upward_weight[/code] must be positive).
Steering weight applying seeded forward-hemisphere random wander at each step ([code]>= 0[/code]).
Deterministic PCG32 random seed controlling start placement, wander, and branching.
Total number of root stems grown ([code]> 0[/code]). Any slots not supplied via [method IvyGenerator.set_start_points] are generated along the bottom wall edge.
Physical distance advanced along the wall surface per growth step ([code]> 0[/code]).
Distance threshold within which a target waypoint is marked reached ([code]> 0[/code]).
Radius within which active tips experience linear pull toward unsatisfied targets during Phase 1. A value of [code]0.0[/code] applies global target pull across the entire wall.
Steering weight pulling active tips toward the nearest unsatisfied target waypoint during Phase 1 ([code]>= 0[/code]).
Base radial thickening applied per step to internal living segments, scaled by [code]sqrt(downstream_active_tips)[/code] ([code]>= 0[/code]).
Steering weight pulling active tips toward the wall's local upward axis ([code]+axis_v[/code]; [code]>= 0[/code]).
Radial shrinkage applied per step to terminated or crowded branches without active downstream tips ([code]>= 0[/code]). Healthy boundary-stopped stems freeze instead of withering.
